The Crust Matter Aggregator's bill looks dense but is only three layers of multiplication — mode, dimension slots and filters, each multiplying its own share. The formula lives in the tooltip; here you learn to see the layers.

Billing splits into a §3plain tier and a dense tier§r, worlds apart; targeted mode filters out exactly what you lack, refreshing the ore pool when switched.

The fortune ceiling follows the currency: §1bare, singularity, critical singularity§r — one ceiling per tier.

§8§oThe last step of digging through the crust is making the crust walk up to you.§r
